annotation.bound_parties_text: The text approves a regulation on unmanned aerial vehicles (VANT) and their systems (SVANT); the excerpt does not name the bound parties, which are inferred as operators and users of such vehicles.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: REGLAMENTO DE VEHICULOS AEREOS NO TRIPULADOS Y DE SISTEMAS DE VEHICULOS AEREOS NO TRIPULADOS
annotation.robot_provision_quote: APRUEBESE EL TEXTO DEFINITIVO DEL “REGLAMENTO DE VEHICULOS AEREOS NO TRIPULADOS (VANT) Y DE SISTEMAS DE VEHICULOS AEREOS NO TRIPULADOS (SVANT)”
